desc: Offline: the Settings shell and picker still open from cache, and a Gamecast shows the friendly error (not a blank screen)

expected: Settings renders; Gamecast shows an error/Try again state or cached content
actual: offline settings view 1385 chars; offline game page: "Couldn’t load data: Request failed (503). Retry"

desc: A client still on the previous service worker (ss-v24 cache + old settings) updates cleanly to ss-v25: old cache dropped, no reload loop, new UI served, settings kept
steps: Via a pass-through proxy that serves /sw.js as "ss-v24" on the first visit (planting a stale ss-v24 cache), then the real sw.js; trigger an update
expected: caches become ss-v25 (+img) only; at most 2 main-frame navigations during the update; Mute page has the new checkbox; stored settings intact (v6, follows kept)
actual: before: ss-v24; after: ss-v25; main-frame navigations during update: 0; new checkbox present=true; settings v6, follow mlb:2
